properties.evidence: service.rs term_weights computes each query term's weight as ln((n+1)/(df+1)) over every served description per call, so any description anywhere adding a common word moves every tool's score on every query holding that word; measured: only compare_designs' description changed, only df("in") moved, and only tools whose descriptions hold "in" (pin_at_epoch, release_includes, release_includes_all) changed score while release_claim and release_report did not.
